items.title: PLC OPC UA security mode
items.description: Confirm target server security matches deployment: None+anonymous for local Prosys only; production plants use Basic256Sha256 SignAndEncrypt with a populated PKI trust store.
items.verificationCommand: Review app.opcua.security.policy on plant-edge-service and OPC UA server endpoint table.
items.passCriteria: Dev uses None only on loopback simulators; secured servers use Basic256Sha256 + non-empty trusted/certs; missing PKI fails startup (no silent None fallback).
items.productionRequirement: Basic256Sha256 SignAndEncrypt + OPC_UA_PKI_DIR with own cert/key and trusted server certs.

items.title: Sign-only mode and certificate UI
items.description: Sign security policy without encrypt, username tokens, and trust-store management UI are deferred.
items.passCriteria: M4.3 delivers Sign policy, extended credentials, and trust-store UX.
items.currentDevPosture: Probe accepts only None | SignAndEncrypt; Sign rejects with SECURITY_MODE_UNSUPPORTED.
items.productionRequirement: Full OPC UA security policy matrix and certificate lifecycle.

items.title: Dev broker posture confined to private network
items.description: Anonymous Mosquitto on :1883 is acceptable only on loopback/VPN; never expose 1883 on the public internet. Enable onboarding probe only during active onboarding windows.
items.verificationCommand: Inspect infra/mosquitto/mosquitto.conf and APP_ONBOARDING_PROBE_ENABLED on central-backend.
items.passCriteria: allow_anonymous true only on dev/VPN; APP_ONBOARDING_PROBE_ENABLED=false in production; no public :1883.
items.currentDevPosture: Anonymous :1883; Paho without TLS/username; probe flag default false.
items.productionRequirement: Per-site broker credentials, ACLs, and TLS (M4.1).

items.title: Production broker auth, ACLs, and TLS
items.description: Mosquitto must reject cross-site and anonymous clients before cutover.
items.passCriteria: M4.1: allow_anonymous false, per-site ACLs, Paho TLS, Caddy HTTPS for CENTRAL_BASE_URL.
items.currentDevPosture: Site-scoped command subscription on edge only; broker ACLs not enforced yet.

items.title: Local edge diagnostics and live SSE
items.description: Verify GET /api/edge/status on loopback and live telemetry in the UI for the onboarded line.
items.passCriteria: OPC UA phase UP (or intentional IDLE with zero tags); mqtt CONNECTED; Step 4 smoke / Live console shows TAG_UPDATE for ACTIVE tags.
items.currentDevPosture: Loopback edge diagnostics; no central staleness sweeper.
items.productionRequirement: MQTT site/{siteId}/edge/status heartbeat and UI staleness (M4.4).

items.title: Central heartbeat, staleness, command timeout sweeper
items.description: Deferred MQTT edge status topic, per-tag age in latest/SSE, and TIMEOUT sweeper.
items.passCriteria: M4.4: heartbeat publish, staleness indicators, @Scheduled TIMEOUT, durable command subscriptions.
items.currentDevPosture: IDLE phase must not be flagged offline in edge UI only.

items.title: Hypertable health and container memory bounds
items.description: Confirm telemetry_history hypertable exists and cloud Postgres memory settings fit CX23.
items.verificationCommand: docker compose exec timescaledb psql -U smartfactory -d smart_factory -c "SELECT hypertable_name FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables WHERE hypertable_name='telemetry_history';"
items.passCriteria: One hypertable row; docker-compose.cloud.yml shared_buffers=256MB, container cap 1024M; disk usage under 70%.
items.currentDevPosture: Flyway V3 hypertable; no automated compression/retention jobs yet.

items.title: Compression, retention, backups
items.description: Automated TimescaleDB lifecycle and backup restore are production gates.
items.passCriteria: M4.5 policies active; backup/restore verified on test snapshot.

items.title: EDGE_SITE_ID and CENTRAL_BASE_URL
items.description: One edge process per site; config sync over HTTP to central, not MQTT.
items.verificationCommand: Verify EDGE_SITE_ID matches registry siteCode and CENTRAL_BASE_URL=http://<central>:8080
items.passCriteria: EDGE_SITE_ID matches ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,63}$ and registry site; config sync enabled; central URL is HTTP API not edge loopback.
items.currentDevPosture: GET /api/edge/{siteId}/config poll 15s; OPEN access until M4.2.

items.title: Multi-plant isolation on one host
items.description: Distinct snapshot path, SQLite WAL buffer, loopback port, and MQTT client id per edge JVM.
items.verificationCommand: Compare env matrix in PLANT_ONBOARDING_PLAYBOOK.md Section 4.
items.passCriteria: No shared EDGE_BUFFER_PATH or EDGE_CONFIG_SNAPSHOT_PATH; unique EDGE_MQTT_CLIENT_ID; foreign siteId snapshots ignored.
items.currentDevPosture: Command client id suffix -commands; cross-site MQTT commands silently dropped.
